class.name: NetwQuantizeScalar
class.brief_description: [NetwQuantize] for a number, or each axis of a [Vector2] or [Vector3], within a range.
class.description: Values between [member min_limit] and [member max_limit] are rounded to [member resolution_step]. Set the precision with [method bits] or with [method step]. [codeblock] var q := NetwQuantizeScalar.new().limits(-2048.0, 2048.0).bits(19) # the same var q := NetwQuantizeScalar.new().limits(-2048.0, 2048.0).step(0.0078) [/codeblock] Call [method limits] before [method step]. Each axis uses [member bit_count] bits, and the error is at most half [member resolution_step].

method.name: bits
method.description: Sets [member bit_count] and returns this quantizer.

method.name: limits
method.description: Sets [member min_limit] and [member max_limit] and returns this quantizer. [member bit_count] does not change, so a wider range gives a larger [member resolution_step].

method.name: step
method.description: Sets [member resolution_step] and returns this quantizer. Call [method limits] first.

members.member: The largest value. Larger values are clamped. Use [NetwQuantizeAngle] for angles.
The smallest value. Smaller values are clamped.
The precision, [code](max_limit - min_limit) / (2 ** bit_count - 1)[/code]. Setting it picks the smallest [member bit_count] that is at least this precise. Must be above [code]0.0[/code].
